d: Pakistan is now facing the consequences of the very terror ecosystem it spent decades nurturing. In a stunning development, Lashkar-e-Taiba deputy chief Saifullah Qasoori has openly threatened Pakistan itself over any possible recognition of Israel. The warning comes as U.S. President Donald Trump pushes Muslim countries, including Pakistan, toward normalising ties with Israel under the Abraham Accords framework. Islamabad has already pushed back publicly, but the pressure has exposed a dangerous fault line inside Pakistan. As Pakistan struggles to balance pressure from Washington,…
